data.name: Durable Cloth
data.description: Used to craft medical supplies.
data.article:
Durable Cloth is a refined material used to craft medical supplies. It helps you progress by letting you create various items. It is also needed for upgrading the Medical Lab and completing Expedition projects.

You can find Durable Cloth by scavenging in medical and commercial areas, often inside containers such as Industrial Drawers and Blue Multi Drawers. Additionally, it can be crafted at a Refiner using salvage materials. You can also obtain it by recycling salvage or by salvaging other items.

data.name: Electrical Components
data.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
data.flavor_text: Used to craft: Tactical Mk.2, Combat Mk.2, Looting Mk.2, Advanced Electrical Components, Surge Shield Recharger
data.article:
Electrical Components are refined materials used for crafting items like Jolt Mines and Surge Shield Rechargers. They are also needed to upgrade your Gear Bench and Utility Station, and for Expedition projects.

You can find these components by defeating ARCs such as the Rocketeer, Vaporizer, Android, and Arc Courier. They are often looted from containers like Breachable Containers, Bags, and Cars. Exploration in the Blue Gate, Stella Montis, Spaceport, Buried City, and Dam Battlegrounds maps can also yield them, particularly during events like Night Raid and Harvester. You can also craft them at a Refiner or recycle them for resources.

arc.name: Comet
arc.description:
Often found guarding heavy machines, the Comet serves as a brutal deterrent against Raiders who attempt flanking tactics. When it acquires a target it accelerates with alarming speed, and triggers its self-destruct once it's near enough to guarantee damage.

Its blast radius is generous and unforgiving, as grouped-up squads have learned the hard way. Its armor plating protects its core, but it opens up when it charges, exposing its vulnerable innards. However, even when exposed, hitting such a fast-moving weak spot requires a particularly skilled trigger finger.

Experienced Raiders treat the Comet as a priority target, dropping it before engaging whatever it's protecting. The alternative is fighting a Bastion while a live bomb circles for an opening. Shani suspects ARC deployed them specifically in response to Raider flanking tactics - another sign that the machines are learning

data.name: Energy Clip
data.description: Ammo used for energy weapons. One clip will fully charge a single weapon.
data.article:
Energy Clips are a type of ammunition used for recharging energy weapons like the Jupiter, Equalizer, and Dolabra. One clip fully recharges a single weapon. This ammunition is effective at penetrating ARC armor, performing at least as well as Heavy Ammo.

You can get Energy Clips in several ways:

  • They are salvaged from defeated ARCs.
  • You can find them by scavenging in the environment.
  • They can be crafted at a Workbench.
  • They are sold by the vendor Tian Wen.

arc.name: Leaper
arc.description: This isn't just an ARC; it's a massive, arachnid-like siege engine. Its heavy armor gives it a hulking, near-indestructible presence on the battlefield, but don't mistake its bulk for sluggishness. This mechanized spider possesses an unnerving, gravity-defying ability to leap vast distances. Reports confirm it has been seen clearing impossible gaps, even bounding effortlessly to the summit of a Spaceport tower. It's a vertical threat you can't simply hide from.

arc.name: ARC Surveyor
arc.description: This is the largest of the rolling ARCs, a massive, spherical construct designed to dominate open ground. Its primary tactic is to stop periodically on the battlefield to transmit disruptive signals, acting as a massive relay for the ARC network. Be warned, however, its most unique (and dangerous) trait is its resilience: as it takes damage, its outer shell breaks apart into many smaller, armored pieces. Its final attack is a relentless one: it will roll directly at high speed toward any Raider it detects, essentially turning itself into a giant, high-impact bowling ball.

data.name: Extended Light Mag I
data.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
data.article:
Extended Light Mag I is a Weapon Mod that makes compatible weapons hold slightly more ammunition. It adds 5 to the magazine size of compatible weapons.

You can find this mod by scavenging, or craft it at a Gunsmith bench level 1. It is also sold by the vendor Tian Wen for 1,920 coins, with a limit of 5 per day.

data.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag II
data.article: The Extended Light Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith Bench, which helps by increasing the ammo capacity of compatible weapons. Blueprints for gun parts, such as this one, are typically found when scavenging Raider Containers, which can appear in any map. They may also be obtained as a reward from Trials. Once you use a blueprint, it is consumed and the recipe becomes permanently available for crafting. If you find a blueprint you already know, it can be sold for 5,000 coins.
